_metadata.status: ADOPTED (engineering disposition) — not yet wired into a test runner

what_it_authorises: CB_211 is preserved byte-for-byte and registered as an explicit, unresolved, fail-closed known discrepancy.
CB_211 must execute on every regression run.
Its exact observed result must be asserted.
It must never be counted as passed.
Any change in its observed behaviour fails the run and requires registry review.
Any additional case mismatch fails the run.
what_it_does_not_authorise: It does not decide between Option B and Option C — both are deferred for clinical/product adjudication before external beta.
It does not constitute clinical approval, external-beta approval or production approval.
It does not permit editing testing/case_bank_v1.json or any expected output.

_metadata.description: Registry of case-bank findings that are known, adjudicated at engineering level, and awaiting a final clinical/product decision. A record here does NOT waive a failure: the case still executes, its exact observed output is asserted, and any deviation fails the run.
not_yet_wired: Option D is adopted as the engineering disposition, but no Mobile test runner reads this file yet.
Wiring it is a separate, separately reviewed Mobile change — see docs/KNOWN_FINDINGS_CONTRACT.md section 4.
_metadata.governing_rule: A known finding is a pinned observation, never a suppressed failure. If a registered case starts behaving differently — better or worse — the run must fail, because the registry's description of reality has become wrong.
_metadata.precedent: Mirrors KNOWN_BASELINE_FINDINGS in tools/report_baseline.py, which records pre-existing unresolved token references and fails on any NEW one.

authoritative_fixture.note: A registry entry is valid only against this exact fixture. If the fixture hash changes, every entry must be re-adjudicated before the registry is used again.

expected_output.source_of_expectation: testing/build_case_bank.py:174-177, hardcoded, note 'matches E3.5 Case 12 behaviour'

safety_impact.rationale: With an empty token set no red-flag rule can match, so there is no flag to suppress. The behaviour is a consequence of the empty input alone and cannot alter any non-empty assessment.

guards.mechanism: line 83 `final isEnabled = tokens.isNotEmpty;` gates line 250 `onPressed: isEnabled ? ... : null`
guards.effect: Continue is disabled while no symptom is selected
blocks before any engine work, records CompletionStatus.interrupted, shows 'Please select at least one symptom to continue.'

findings.decision_status_meaning: The ENGINEERING disposition is settled: preserve CB_211 unchanged and hold it here, fail-closed, until adjudicated. The finding itself remains UNRESOLVED — the clinical/product choice between Option B (correct the expectation in a new versioned bank) and Option C (engine-level empty-input result) is deferred and must be made before external beta.

re_review_if: the case bank fixture hash changes
CB_211 observed output changes in any field
UrgencyDeterminer gains or removes an urgencySource value
either product guard is removed, weakened, or bypassed by a new entry point
a new caller invokes EngineController.run() without an empty-input check

must: execute CB_211 exactly as it is authored — never skip it, never filter it out
compare the observed output against `observed_output` in this registry, field by field
fail the run if any observed field differs from the registry
fail the run if any case NOT listed here mismatches its expected output
fail the run if the case bank fixture hash differs from `authoritative_fixture.sha256`
report every registry entry prominently in the run summary, with its decision_status
must_not: count a registered case toward the pass total
silently downgrade a failure to a warning
treat an empty or unreadable registry as permission to ignore a failure
runner_contract.reporting: A run with registered findings and no other failures is reported as e.g. '238 passed, 1 known finding (CB_211, open — awaiting engineering lead and clinical), 0 unexpected failures'. The known-finding count is never folded into the pass count.
